claims: Cowork landed on mobile and web alongside desktop; scheduled tasks now run in the cloud with the laptop shut
Sessions can follow you across devices (start on phone, finish at desk)

Catch: sync is one-way; everything built in a desktop session stays on that computer, phone/web cannot see it, so mobile Claude 'drops back to generic Claude that knows nothing about you' if your setup lives in a local folder
His workaround keeps the 'coworker OS' live on every device online/offline using Skills, Connectors and Dropbox (how-to promised on YouTube)
how_to_steps: Move context/instruction files out of a purely local folder into things Cowork syncs: Skills and Connectors, plus a Dropbox-hosted folder
Full method deferred to the 'Systems Made Better' YouTube channel or the paid template

relevance.why: Haji works in Claude Code with cloud sessions and connectors, where this local-folder gap mostly does not apply. The warning is useful if he ever leans on Cowork desktop local folders.

implement_score.why: Takeaway only: keep instruction files in a synced repo/connector rather than a desktop-only Cowork folder. No build needed.

gap.what: Adds a warning missing from the liked Cowork-mobile news video: desktop local-folder context does not sync to mobile/web (one-way), plus the Dropbox/Skills/Connectors workaround.
